deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is December 31 (for visit invitations); a regular Admissions deadline also applies.

funding.value: Funding is offered depending on qualifications and performance.
funding.quote: Ph.D. applicants may be considered for teaching assistantships, research assistantships and fellowships depending on qualifications and performance

entry_route.value: A 4-year bachelor's degree or a master's in biomedical engineering or a closely related field is accepted.
entry_route.quote: 4-year bachelor’s or a master’s degree in biomedical engineering or a closely related field from an accredited institution

notes: Requires GPA of 3.0 in the bachelor's (last 60 credits) and 3.3 in a master's per the department page.
